description: Erection of a single storey side extension to replace existing timber frame
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A105, A106, A107  Received:  30 March 2020
A101, A102, A103, A104, Unreferenced Location Plan, Unreferenced Block Plan  Received:  11 February 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The approved replacement single storey side extension shall be constructed with matching red brick walls and matching roof tiles to the original house.  The front and rear timbre panel fa?ades, including both the front and rear access doors, shall also be retained with their existing designs and heights.  

No barbed wire shall be installed or retained above the walls of the single storey side extension and its timbre panel front and rear facades under any circumstances.
Condition : 4 - No additional doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The single storey side extension hereby approved shall be used as an ancillary space to the original house only, including by providing direct access to the rear garden from the front forecourt, shall not be converted to and form an independent means of access to a subdivided self-contained dwelling and shall be permanently retained as such.
